a18.question: Does a local Testcontainers Vault count as 'a dev Vault' for AC-4?

reasons.text: AC-4 text: the test proves 'the backend token reads studio/{csiId}/{environment}/{testId}/secret/* only and that write/list outside are denied'. Design I-C9 (secret-login-design.md:144) makes the policy 'Required (deployment)', read granted 'to the backend identity only', Vault side 'outside this repository'.
A container whose policy and token the test authors proves only its own policy text (circular); it says nothing about the deployed backend identity's policy binding.
009 dependency notes: 'dev Vault' is an external prerequisite 'named at T0 and never faked'; register U5 owner is PUT Core / BFF (ED-02).
GO condition 3: Done is unreachable while AC-4's Vault policy test is unrun; AC preamble: absent external => 'unrun, owner X', never a pass, never a silent skip.

canProve.text: Our policy text allows in-scope read and denies sibling test/other env/other CSI, list/write outside scope
HashicorpStudioVaultProvider against real KV v2 (bounded read, cas=0 create, metadata list); settles the adapter Javadoc inference about 403 on duplicate create, for the pulled Vault version only
The adapter needs create + metadata list, while the design says the policy 'grants read'; a read-only policy would break save
KV v2 policy paths use <mount>/data/ and <mount>/metadata/; verifies the template-to-glob match

cannotProve.text: Deployed mount, KV config (cas), namespace, Vault version
Auth method and role-to-policy binding of the backend identity; that the real token carries only this policy; TTL/renewal; STUDIO_VAULT_TOKEN_FILE delivered by the chart
Runner pod has no network path to Vault (config refusal and NetworkPolicy render are local; reachability is not)
Audit device, retention, KV v2 version-history residual
That the tested Vault is the one each environment's backend uses

creditRuleForDevVault: Instance operated by the ED-02 owner (PUT Core / BFF), Vault version named
Policy under test read from that Vault or supplied by the owner, sha256 recorded; not authored by the test
Token issued through the same auth method/role the deployed backend uses (or the backend's actual token); pod need not be deployed
Denial matrix executed: in-scope read, in-scope create/list as needed by the adapter; other CSI, other env, other test, list/write outside denied
Record timestamp, tester, backend/dist identity in vault-policy.json with mode 'dev-vault'
